records.notes: Editions compared (all opened as PDF): DS40GS/1112 (2012, O&G GS, C10550201): PR 9.7:1, airflow 18.4 kg/s, max speed 14,950 rpm, 9.8x2.6x3.2 m, 'Typical Weight: 31 620 kg (69,710 lb)'. DS40PG/0113 (2013, PG, C10550175 and Spanish C10574559): PR 10:1, 'Package Weight: 31 600 kg (69,600 lb)'. DS40PG/1118 (2018, PG, CM20150703-52095-62290, newest data sheet): 3515 kWe, 12 910 kJ/kWe-hr, 68 365 kg/hr, 445 C, PR 10:1, airflow 18.7 kg/s, 'Package Weight: 30 460 kg (67,150 lb) Dry weight, enclosed height'. Power Generation Product Handbook BPGPH/0525 (2025, CM20190218-53670-53247, newest Solar document opened): 3.5 MW, 12,900 kJ/kWe-hr, 27.9 %, 19.0 kg/s, 443 C (829 F), package 9.8x2.6x3.2 m, 33,480 kg / 73,280 lb (the kg and lb figures disagree: 33,480 kg = 73,810 lb; 73,280 lb = 33,240 kg). Turbomach handbook BPHBTBM/512 (2012): 3.51 MW, 12'900, 18.99 kg/s, 443 C, T-4700. Taken: power/heat rate/flow/temp from DS40PG/1118 (matches search-index text of the current solarturbines.com GS page: 3515 kWe, 12,910 kJ/kW-hr, 68,365 kg/hr, 445 C - page itself returned HTTP 403 Akamai, not opened); handbook 443 C / 12,900 recorded as alternative. PR changed 9.7 -> 10.0 (newest sheet DS40PG/1118; 9.7 only in older O&G sheet DS40GS/1112). out_rpm changed 14944 -> 14950 max: 14,944 (50 Hz) / 14,951 (60 Hz) came from a PSU thesis appendix (engr.psu.edu, not an allowed host, not opened). pkg_kg kept 33,480 (newest, dry unenclosed); lighter editions 31,620 / 31,600 / 30,460 kg listed above; Turbomach 2012 handbook gives 40 t / 10.0x2.2x6.6 m 'including Filter system and for outdoor installation'. eff_pct is the published 'Engine efficiency: 27.9%' (3600/12910 = 27.9 confirms). exh_flow_kg_s = published 68 365 kg/hr / 3600 (also printed as 18.99 kg/s by Turbomach). No Centaur 40 Turbomachinery Package Specification was reachable on allowed hosts (manualsdir has only the Taurus 60 TPS; TPS40CSMD copies are on scribd/directindustry/pdfcoffee, not allowed), so engine mass/size, starter kW, fuel gas pressure, lube volumes, bleed valves and engine change time remain unverified.

records.notes: Editions compared (opened PDFs): DS40MD/0416 (2016, C10550211), DS40CS/0416 (2016 compressor set, C10550270), Spanish DS40MD-ES/0416 (C10574541) and DS40CS-ES/0416 (C10574543) - all identical: 3500 kW (4700 hp), 12 905 kJ/kW-hr, 68 185 kg/hr, 445 C (835 F), PR 10.3:1, 18.7 kg/s, GP 2-stage 15,000 rpm max, PT 1-stage 15,500 rpm max, driver skid 6.0x2.5x2.7 m, 14 970 kg. exh_temp_C changed 450 -> 445: the 450 came from a search-index snippet of the current solarturbines.com MD page ('835ºF (450ºC)'); that page returned HTTP 403 (Akamai) on two attempts 30 s apart and was not opened. All opened Solar sheets print '445°C (835°F)'; 835 F is 446 C, so the snippet's 450 C is internally inconsistent with its own 835 F. L/W/H now sourced from Solar's own sheet DS40MD/0416 instead of third-party ETN (values unchanged). Dimensions/weight are driver package only, dry, unenclosed height. eff_pct is published ('Engine efficiency: 27.9%'); 3600/12905 = 27.9 confirms. exh_flow_kg_s = published 68 185 kg/hr / 3600. Nominal PT speed and speed range not published in the data sheets (rating stated at 'Optimum power turbine speed'); would need TPS40CSMD (not reachable on allowed hosts).
